query: INSERT INTO job_outbox (id, job_type, payload, dedupe_key, available_at, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) WHERE dedupe_key IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload, available_at = CASE WHEN job_outbox.dispatched_at IS NULL THEN LEAST(job_outbox.available_at, EXCLUDED.available_at) ELSE EXCLUDED.available_at END, dispatched_at = NULL RETURNING id
